title: Kemeleon EncodeEk / DecodeEk test vectors for ML-KEM encapsulation keys
spec: draft-irtf-cfrg-kemeleon-02 sections 4.1 and 4.2 as updated on main (corrected bound on m; ek parsed and rebuilt with ByteDecode_12/ByteEncode_12), with the little-endian serialization proposed in ssveitch/draft-kemeleon PR #20, all as of commit 63dfd776cecd2f569a087b318fea6f2cd3e0a201
generated_by: Original eighteen cases adapted from the PQPAKE EncodeEk/DecodeEk contribution; twelve additional t=76 cases produced by test-vectors/generate-t76-followup.py from pinned NIST ACVP inputs; checked by test-vectors/verify-encode-ek.py

conventions.field: For each polynomial i, r_i = sum_j a_i[j] * q^j (a_i[0] least significant), and y_i = r_i + m_i * q^n is serialized as field_bytes in little-endian order; field_bytes = (2996 + t) / 8.
conventions.layout: eek = field_0 || ... || field_(k-1) || rho; rho is copied unchanged.
conventions.bound: m_i is in [0, floor((2^(b+t) - 1 - r_i) / q^n)], ensuring 0 <= y_i < 2^(b+t).
conventions.ek: Where d and z are present, ek = ML-KEM.KeyGen_internal(d, z) (FIPS 203 Algorithm 16); the ACVP cases allow an independent check of ek.
conventions.hex: Byte strings are lowercase hexadecimal; each m is a lowercase hexadecimal integer without a 0x prefix or leading zeroes.
conventions.decode_only: Vectors without d, z, or m exercise DecodeEk on inputs that EncodeEk need not produce; decoding is total for every correctly sized byte string.
